description: This file defines the JavaScript class 'Datetimecombo' used for handling date and time selection UI components in a SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for rendering the UI, updating date/time values, and managing interactions.

classes.name: Datetimecombo
classes.description: A JavaScript class for managing a date and time picker widget, including rendering, updating, and interaction handling.

methods.name: Datetimecombo
methods.description: Constructor function initializing the date/time picker with provided parameters and setting up initial state.

methods.name: jsscript(callback)
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for updating the date/time selection based on user input, invoking a callback.

methods.name: html(callback)
methods.description: Renders the HTML for the date/time picker UI, including dropdowns for hours, minutes, and meridiem, as well as optional checkbox.

methods.name: update(updateListeners)
methods.description: Synchronizes the internal date/time value based on UI selections and triggers change events, managing checkbox state if present.
